name: stock-details
description: Stage 0, after stock-behaviour, in DAW mode (relative encoders, so nothing clamps): encoder steps per revolution (only with a mark on the knob: the knobs have no pointer and no detents), the CC of encoders 2 and 8, the MIDI channel of faders 2 and 8, fader touch, several faders at once. Read-only: nothing is sent to the mixer. No BT, no power-on key combinations.

steps.text: Hold Shift and look at ◀ and ▶. If ▶ is lit, press ◀ while still holding Shift (DAW mode). Release.
steps.ask: Which arrow is lit while Shift is held now?

steps.text: Only if you can put a mark on encoder 1 (a bit of tape or a marker dot), otherwise press s: turn encoder 1 clockwise exactly one full revolution, slowly (about 3 s), stopping at the mark.
Only with the mark, otherwise s: turn encoder 1 counter-clockwise exactly one full revolution, slowly.
Only with the mark, otherwise s: turn encoder 1 clockwise exactly one full revolution, as fast as is comfortable.
Turn encoder 2 a little clockwise, then a little counter-clockwise.
Turn encoder 8 a little clockwise, then a little counter-clockwise.
Touch the cap of fader 1 without moving it, keep the finger on it for 2 s, take it off.
Move fader 2 from the bottom to the top and back to the bottom.
Move fader 8 from the bottom to the top and back to the bottom.
With one hand, move faders 1 to 4 together from the bottom to the top and back to the bottom.
